identity_scope: Study the four supplied complete neutral singlet molecular identities and their molecular optical response in dichloromethane. Side-chain stereochemistry is a known synthetic identity; backbone helicity, relevant conformations, populations and transition assignments are to be investigated. The supplied graphs do not prescribe a three-dimensional backbone. Ancillary HPLC/NMR observations retain their own experimental media and do not establish a dichloromethane equilibrium distribution. A reduced model requires an explicit relationship to the full molecular identity and a justification adequate for its claim. Periodic crystals, charge transport, photocurrent dissymmetry and device efficiency are outside the required molecular question.
provenance: Constitution and side-chain identity from main Figure1a/SI synthesis; experimental optical facts from main p2 Figure1b–d; unassigned chromatographic/NMR observations from SI pp11–13. Source optimized coordinates, inferred helicity, computed energies, transition labels and mechanistic interpretations remain private or PR-only.
